description: This file defines database models and related methods for a Flask web application, including user roles, permissions, user authentication, posts, comments, and follow relationships.

classes.name: Permission
classes.description: Defines permission levels as class variables for user roles.

classes.name: Role
classes.description: Represents user roles with associated permissions and methods to manage them.

classes.name: Follow
classes.description: Models the follower-followed relationship between users with timestamp.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Represents application users with authentication, profile, and relationship methods.

classes.name: AnonymousUser
classes.description: Defines behavior for anonymous users in the login system.

classes.name: Post
classes.description: Represents user posts with content, timestamp, and related comments.

classes.name: Comment
classes.description: Represents comments on posts with content, timestamp, and author information.

methods.name: insert_roles
methods.description: Initializes default roles and permissions in the database.

methods.name: add_permission
methods.description: Adds a permission to a role.

methods.name: remove_permission
methods.description: Removes a permission from a role.

methods.name: reset_permissions
methods.description: Resets all permissions for a role.

methods.name: has_permission
methods.description: Checks if a role has a specific permission.

methods.name: add_self_follows
methods.description: Ensures each user follows themselves.

methods.name: verify_password
methods.description: Verifies a password against the stored hash.

methods.name: generate_confirmation_token
methods.description: Generates a token to confirm user email.

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Confirms a user's email with a token.

methods.name: generate_reset_token
methods.description: Generates a token to reset password.

methods.name: reset_password
methods.description: Resets a user's password using a token.

methods.name: generate_email_change_token
methods.description: Creates a token for changing email address.

methods.name: change_email
methods.description: Changes user's email after verifying token.

methods.name: can
methods.description: Checks if user has a specific permission.

methods.name: is_administrator
methods.description: Checks if user has admin permission.

methods.name: ping
methods.description: Updates user's last seen timestamp.

methods.name: gravatar_hash
methods.description: Generates MD5 hash of user's email for gravatar.

methods.name: gravatar
methods.description: Returns gravatar URL for user's avatar.

methods.name: follow
methods.description: Follows another user.

methods.name: unfollow
methods.description: Unfollows a user.

methods.name: is_following
methods.description: Checks if current user is following another user.

methods.name: is_followed_by
methods.description: Checks if current user is followed by another user.

methods.name: followed_posts
methods.description: Retrieves posts from followed users.

methods.name: to_json
methods.description: Serializes user data to JSON format.

methods.name: generate_auth_token
methods.description: Creates an authentication token for user.

methods.name: verify_auth_token
methods.description: Verifies an authentication token and returns user.

methods.name: on_changed_body
methods.description: Converts markdown to sanitized HTML for posts and comments.

methods.name: to_json
methods.description: Serializes post data to JSON format.

methods.name: from_json
methods.description: Creates a Post object from JSON data.

methods.name: on_changed_body
methods.description: Converts markdown to sanitized HTML for comments.

methods.name: to_json
methods.description: Serializes comment data to JSON format.

methods.name: from_json
methods.description: Creates a Comment object from JSON data.
